tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_integers
tests.intent: Verify that definite-length CBOR arrays containing various integer sizes are parsed correctly via the scalar run path.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_negative_integers
tests.intent: Verify that definite-length CBOR arrays containing negative integers are parsed correctly.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_floats_and_booleans
tests.intent: Verify that floats, doubles, booleans, and nulls inside definite-length arrays are parsed correctly.

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_mixed_transition
tests.intent: Verify that the scalar run correctly transitions to regular parsing when encountering a non-scalar (like a string).

tests.name: cbor_scalar_run_boundary_bytes
tests.intent: Verify that the scalar run safely stops when fewer than 9 bytes remain in the input buffer.

tests.name: cbor_empty_array
tests.intent: Verify that empty definite-length arrays bypass the scalar run completely without issues.

tests.name: cbor_indefinite_array
tests.intent: Verify that indefinite-length arrays do not trigger the definite-length scalar run code.

tests.name: cbor_non_contiguous_stream
tests.intent: Verify that non-contiguous inputs (like std::istringstream) correctly fall back to the safe non-bulk parsing path.

tests.name: cbor_nested_arrays
tests.intent: Verify that nested arrays invoke the scalar run appropriately per array level without failing container bookkeeping.

tests.name: cbor_array_of_objects
tests.intent: Verify that an array starting with objects avoids the scalar run correctly and parses objects normally.

tests.name: cbor_sax_event_logging
tests.intent: Verify that SAX event sequence and parameters remain identical during scalar runs.

tests.name: cbor_large_uint64_scalar
tests.intent: Verify parsing of 64-bit unsigned integers via the scalar run path.

tests.name: cbor_large_int64_scalar
tests.intent: Verify parsing of 64-bit negative integers via the scalar run path.

tests.name: cbor_float_source_string_empty
tests.intent: Verify that number_float receives an empty string source parameter during float parsing.

tests.name: cbor_sax_short_circuit_abort
tests.intent: Verify that if the SAX parser aborts during a scalar run, parsing halts and returns false.

tests.name: cbor_mixed_array_various_types
tests.intent: Verify parsing of arrays with interleaved low and high scalar tag bytes.

tests.name: cbor_single_element_scalar_array
tests.intent: Verify a definite-length array containing exactly one scalar element.

tests.name: cbor_unsupported_scalar_head_fallback
tests.intent: Verify that unknown or unsupported head bytes gracefully fall back or terminate the scalar run correctly.

tests.name: cbor_array_exact_element_count
tests.intent: Verify that the scalar run correctly respects the exact remaining count of elements specified by the array header.
